caption: Girls, can we just take a moment for these Vans?! The classic black and white checkerboard design was already a favourite, but add SEQUINS and I’m completely sold! I absolutely love how they give a little sparkle to an everyday outfit without being too much. I’ve styled them with black leggings and an oversized white jumper and honestly, it’s such a cute, effortless look. Perfect for those days when you want to be comfy but still have something a little different on your feet! If you’ve been eyeing these up, this is your sign to get them! I’ve popped these exact sequin Vans in the orange basket below!
